text_block_list.text: Yeah... I was watching TV till late.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Have you seen those shopping channels
with the
dramatized ads?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Like the ones where they're like... "I
collapsed
after working long hours!
That's why I drink this
wellness juice! ♪"
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
They sure pick the worst time to air that
kind of
stuff, but they pull me in every
time.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Yawn... Oh, there was also one about a futon that makes you sleep better.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Late-night shopping channels have kept
Nice
Nature up binge-watching...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
